label: target-ssh-source-pin-after-transfer
script:
cd <WORKDIR>/E4
ssh -n -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o HostKeyAlias=e4-service -o UserKnownHostsFile="$PWD/service_known_hosts" -o HostKeyAlgorithms=ssh-ed25519 -i id_ed25519 -p 22147 root@127.0.0.1 'hostname; cat /etc/machine-id; ssh-keygen -lf /srv/e4/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub'
echo SSH_RC=$?
